Content: The settling of seasonal time in the aftermath of the crisis also shifted the movement of humans.

In some places borders are no longer necessary as people move as freely as the wind. Where there are still borders, they are not determined by territories belonging to one group or the other. These borders are guided by the best functions of that particular territory. The land has spoken and there those who know how to listen, even the art of dowsing is highly referred. In this way all of initially welcomed, due to the need for rest, but then they are asked to move to other territories based on their needs, natural kinship to the land. Some may be innately directed by the bodies of water, and so they will move towards the rivers, lakes, streams, and oceans. Others are by nature closer to the earth and crave the stillness of the Rock Ancestors. They will be invited to live in the mountains or in the adjacent valleys.
When my feet touched ground that was not of my birth, I was welcomed, as well as the olive oil of my peoples. And when the families of an island that the ocean consumed due to our past
failure to honor the sea, the winds and earth, we welcomed them with a home, food and communal blessings.

Nation-states dissolved into collectives of peoples, who saw stewardship as their sacred responsibility. And because of the realization that each set of peoples were all peoples, the people of the snow mount to the people of the sun, peoples far and wide embraced stewardship of the entire earth, not just the land that their feet touched or the water that they drank.
A new flow of peoples emerged. One that followed seasons, hearts, physical and spiritual necessities, like the birds. Once called migration, The Flow, was embraced as a natural way of being.
Right to roam. Land would be shared and cared for.
A place like Maji ya Chai could be a welcoming camp for people who are migrating... moving due to climate changes, fires etc. People would be seamlessly cared for in migration
People do not worry about having a home, home exists whether nomadic or stationary.

Borders are more permeable and welcoming. What was the US takes responsibility for the harm it causes/d in other countries and this one too, and offers some kind of reparation/remuneration which has reduced disparities
We can be with each other without being encumbered by what we have or don't have - citizenship. Freely loving, without people hurting us.

We know how to meet each other. Whether by hugs or a gentle bow - whether by eyes that meet or intentionally don't meet - we find ways to recognize each other's dignity and value. We've moved beyond borders. Laughter and love abounds, and grief and burdens are shared.
Borders are now love lines. As we pass we are greeting one another, passing on useful information, and giving warm welcomes. Fences welcome, include, and attract friends we didn’t know before.
I see the border wall actually being lifted away. People are celebrating together. There is love. My children/grandchildren etc. are there.
We will live in peace and don’t need military - only the roles of our tribes and people are known and respected.
There are no borders, no nations.

There are no borders. Our values reflect Indigenous values. There is justice, storytelling and knowledge, preserving land for future generations, general sharing, focusing on the other person, community, sharing of child rearing, good education, embracing people without fear.
Everybody has what they need. Borders are fluid.
There are no borders; people move freely but always in connection to the beings and land that they are rooted to and with respect for the beings and land that they are entering.
A world without borders is a world that's less human focused. More future oriented. Material needs are not the concern, they are met. Ethos of boundlessness and imagination.
No borders

Borderless world in which we all understand the connection between the borders around land and the borders around ourselves. All bodies have access to pleasure and joy, regardless of what they look like. Art and storytelling is collectively supported and funded. Everyone has free, accessible, genderless contraception.
The land is free.  There are no more enclosures – instead of jobs there are responsibilities, duties, and roles.

Relationships between nation states and those kind of bodies. No ours, no yours. Fluidity between borders. You need the corn this season - here’ sthe corn. You need the water - here’s the water. No hoarding. How do we share? Reverse Pangea - sense of connectedness, force & impulse. Maps morphing again, not separated.
Bridging borders. How can we eliminate these borders? Who put them in place?

There are no borders anymore.  When we walk into the streets we see people, and immediately feel and understand the shared struggles with violence and colonization they have experienced–and the ways they have persevered.  Everyone speaks enough of multiple languages to get connect in deep spoken and unspoken ways.

Technologies make borders meaningless. Two people from distinct parts of the world, with distinct cultures, and distinct languages are able to carry a back and forth conversation about the ways natural resources are stewarded in the place they’re from.
There are many nations of people. Nations that are sustainable because of their relationship to the land and each other. Borders are welcoming.
“The sun is glimmering into open space , children were playing by a river that used to be a border… they hopped across it with ease.

Content: Joy is fully present. No person lives in fear of being separated.

Content: Multigenerational families live or visit each other often. We don’t miss birthdays, celebrations, Sunday lunch at grandmas, funerals, due to borders.

Date/Circle Name: 3/11/25 Community Change Women of Color retreat
Content: We can move freely across borders and hug our loved ones, meet new people, and experience new culture.
We are like birds without borders and the old hassles of passports.

We won’t have borders anymore as people can connect without any time and place limitations. Future generations are kinder, wiser , insightful, knowledgeable and more caring towards one another. We will become a Big Big Family!

A welcome basket. We cross borders freely and there is community and a welcome basket that helps guide people with food and music. As you are crossing, you are adding to the community to grow the welcome basket. We see people as contributing to the growing, expansive culture.

There are countries just for the names and history but borders no longer exist, everyone can visit, but most everyone has a home settled and they are happy because there is abundance everywhere, every country is safe and beautiful.
There are no borders. People move freely and are greeted with kindness. They bring gifts to share with those they are meeting for the first time.
Borders are broken down allowing people to freely come and go as they please. Resources are abundant. People work together to build new paths.

It’s as if people are being guided to a passage through a space. Like portals where people come in from and out through. There is always somewhere to receive people when they move through a border- a home, a community, always welcome to a space where  food is available, their needs are met, and people are received with curiosity and joy.
There are no borders here.
Our own Berlin, with bloodied and hurting hands on sides of sides of sides, we prioritized seeing each other again. It began by reaching for worlds just beyond our reach.

We greet familiar strangers with ‘’my heart knows your heart”.

Rituals of welcome are commonplace and anticipated. 

Belonging includes moving amongst communities fluidly, based on current needs, interests, skills, resources, desires, and curiosity. 

There are no countries or borders like there are now. 

People identify with place, but it's not something to defend or even protect - merely a way to identify someone's location and possible lineage or ways of life.

Belonging is inherent.
No borders, global freedom to be and go everywhere.
We care for a global environment and global citizenship.  There are no more “immigrants” in the othering sense…we are all immigrants.
Handheld translation will be the norm.
Trade across the old borders is free and fair
We live in a world that has no borders
Boarders exist, but are in flux
Something new is emerging – children being born global citizens with freedom & responsibility to be in relationship all over the world
I imagine a world without borders, with equity in education, healthcare, and employment.
Open borders and sharing of culture and ideas. No more war.
There are no more borders.
We are no longer stuck on arbitrary borders - and we understand the ways migration had and will continue to occur based on climate, work and food needs.
We are so aware of and understanding of our interconnectedness that there is no need for government and borders. We understand it is unnatural.
I ride my bike across what used to be a border to a neighbor's house like I used to as a child
Cultural connectors instead of border patrol to help people integrate into new spaces
Earth no longer has imaginary borders. We flow around the globe.
We live in paradise without borders with happy and healthy people around us.
Borders can’t tear families apart.
There are earth cake pops for the 50th anniversary of the last country’s border being erased.  Everyone eats them at the same hour to celebrate this.  We are good at celebrations.

The carceral state will be abolished. Our understanding of security will be unlearned. Jail cells will become jungles where people will be supported to heal from their mistakes. Seven generations from now, borders will no longer exist. People will move freely from place to place and wars will not need to take place over land or resources. Borders look like invitations; a beautiful sign marking togetherness.
Without borders there are no borders.

Having no borders- my grandfather talked to me about. My grandfather was raised and taught by his grandfather. He would tell me that a long time ago there were no borders on Navajo nation. Ride a horse, meet up with family, go talk to people. There were no fences, no gates, nothing to hinder his travels- all the obstacles-fences, walls, gates- degrading over time. Those barriers are not maintained. Becoming an apprentice to a medicine man and grandfather- 2-3 days journey for miles on the road- reducing borders, obstacles, visiting family in another country. Returning to cultural ceremonies- can’t retain info bc not constant- return again and again to retain the information. More consistency. Back to NM.
Where borders acted like scars and separated us, we cultivated connection.

No more borders...everyone is free to move; to see family; to see the world; being able to enjoy the resources everywhere. No one gets in jail just because a country decides they're illegal. Sort of time-travel exists, like being able to beam places. People move freely.

Since state agents no longer terrorize our communities and we are not under surveillance, borders are open and available for anyone to enter no matter their citizenship. Borders are blurred and people travel easily between spaces, connecting with family members and loved ones.
All people have the opportunity to return to their countries of origin and can do so without being persecuted.
Original of Translation: Todas las personas tienen la posibilidad de regresar a sus países de origen y pueden regresar sin ser perseguidos.

Content: We have borders only to divide countries, but we are all human beings regardless of where we come from.
Original of Translation: Tenemos las fronteras solo para dividir países pero todos somos seres humanos viniendo de el lado que vengamos.
